title: AI Software Engineer, Azure, Co-Pilot, Python, C#, .NET, JavaScript, City, London
description:
AI Software Engineer, AI Solutions Engineer, AI Software Developer, Python, JavaScript, Co-Pilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, City of London


AI Software Engineer required to work for a Professional Services business based in the City of London. This will be a role that is 3 days per week in the office and 2 from home.


This role is for a hands-on AI Solutions Engineer who can design, build, deploy and support practical AI solutions across the firm, turning Proof of Concepts into reality. The successful candidate will combine AI platform expertise with strong software development skills and will be comfortable working directly with high-end business stakeholders and business services teams to turn business requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.


You will have experience with the likes of:


  • Hands on Software Development / Engineering
  • C# / .NET background
  • Python
  • JavaScript
  • Co-Pilot Studio
  • Azure AI Foundry
  • Azure DevOps
  • Agentic AI
  • LLMs
  • NLP
  • Machine Learning Fundamentals
  • Working in a heavily regulated environment with the ability to cut through this and still deliver effective solutions


This is a great opportunity and salary is dependent upon experience. Apply now for more details…
